acceptanceCriteria: Provide a fixed, explicitly approved and pinned Storybook tag-selection mechanism, or retain an exact unsupported tuple; no injected arbitrary argv or silent omission of skip semantics.

Run the real Storybook 10.6.1/test-runner 0.26.0/Jest 30.5.2 tuple through the common executor with a pass, deliberate failure and tagged skip; preserve the original optional-config startup failure and input hashes.

Verify native report identity and expected inventory, no-tests/setup failure and ordinary plus browser-descendant cleanup; retain independent review, focused tests and immutable change evidence before qualification.
body: Confirmed experimental adapter capability gap found during owner-authorized parallel CEM 1.0 work. Installed Core 1.0.0-rc.1 build163; delivered source/seal 163b46d581228f9cca09482b8e89aff77540897a. Storybook 10.6.1 with test-runner 0.26.0 and Jest 30.5.2 refuses module.register when loading the optional .storybook/test-runner.js inside Jest. The exact fixture config only duplicates --skipTags skip-test. Independent startup review permits omission for that fixture, without suppressing hooks or assertions. One actual cold native browser invocation then produced 1 pass, 1 deliberate failure and 1 skip (expected exit1), with all 17 observed processes and three process groups retired and no forced containment. Native evidence: /private/tmp/cem10-build/storybook-compat-next/runtime/runtime-summary.json, SHA256 8c6eeef019573486bd98ba6f7bf7452af4698e5e4b74b6e70152da514bdd5924. However, the committed fixed common runner profile has no skipTags field; the exact native invocation cannot be represented without source repair or arbitrary argument injection. Common-executor qualification remains NOT_OBSERVED, full negative/lifecycle coverage remains open, and the original failure is preserved. This bounded gap supports the existing broad dynamic runner release ticket V1-0592; neither is complete. Deduplicated native ticket search --text Storybook returned no matching item.
title: Storybook fixed runner profile cannot preserve native skipTags qualification
